purpose: resolve acquisition provenance, full-population coverage, and pallet-local depth structure before any coordinate correction
teacher_role: ROI proposal only; teacher correctness is not evaluated
teacher_recipe_source: data/pallet/results/paper_selftrain_v1/teacher_cache/R0_TEACHER_CACHE.json — recipe and flip_contract are read from that file, not restated here
important_corrections_to_gate0: different intrinsics do NOT forbid pooling; each frame/recording must use its own K
cam_K.txt existence does NOT by itself prove that it is the color-stream intrinsic
same-K backprojection/reprojection round trip validates algebra only, not RGB-depth calibration
whole-ROI background contamination does NOT prove absence of local pallet depth structure

roi_definitions.ROI_B: convex hull of the valid predicted 8 corners
roi_definitions.ROI_C: projected cuboid face interiors, each polygon shrunk toward its own centroid

shrink_ratio_justification: no interior-margin convention exists in this repository, so the value is declared here before any measurement and is never swept afterwards; 20 percent is the value named in the task specification

plane_fit.method: deterministic least squares via PCA on the backprojected points

provenance_grades.A_EXPLICIT: recording or session metadata, or an execution record for that recording, links it to a capture writer whose contract states alignment, scale and K
provenance_grades.B_STRONG: history, log or provenance links this capture series to a specific writer or pipeline whose contract is clear
provenance_grades.C_COMPATIBLE_ONLY: current reader or live code consumes this format as aligned depth, but nothing links the raw recording to how it was produced

PROVENANCE_CONDITION.CONTRACT_CONFIRMED: every recording intended for the method reaches A_EXPLICIT or B_STRONG on the contracts metric reconstruction needs

LOCAL_SIGNAL_CONDITION.requirement: over half of detected ROI frames have at least one projected face interior that holds enough valid depth to fit a plane numerically and is not a catastrophic spread
LOCAL_SIGNAL_CONDITION.why_open: no repository or physical contract fixes these numbers, and inventing them after seeing the distribution would be fitting to the result
LOCAL_SIGNAL_CONDITION.if_no_defensible_number_is_found: report LOCAL_SIGNAL = DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY rather than manufacturing a pass
LOCAL_SIGNAL_CONDITION.one_number_that_is_defensible: a face interior needs at least 3 valid depth points for a plane to be defined at all; that is geometry, not a tuned threshold

alignment_diagnostic.add: symmetric chamfer distance between RGB structural edges and depth discontinuity edges
alignment_diagnostic.keep: the existing Gate 0 edge proxy is not discarded
alignment_diagnostic.forbidden: using the best shift to move the depth, or to correct an offset; this is verification only

contact_sheet_selection.rule: per recording, deterministic representatives from close, mid and far bands of teacher bbox area

verdict_axes.ready_requires: acquisition contract sufficiently recovered AND local pallet depth signal actually present AND alignment evidence not contradictory

allowed_new_inference: R0 ROI proposals for adaptation frames that no existing cache covers, under the recipe read from R0_TEACHER_CACHE.json
forbidden: moving depth by the best shift
gate1_after_success: Gate 1 compares teacher raw coordinates against depth-corrected coordinates for pseudo-label quality. Even a successful Gate 0B does not start student training.
